page.overview:
Who is Raphael?

Raphael appears in the live action series, , as well as its crossover episode with Power Rangers in Space.

Raph became the rebel of the group, often sparring with . Raphael is a total hothead, who immediately jumps into battle without thinking. That's why he often clashes with Leonardo, who prefers to make a plan rather than simply rushing into battle.

His weapons are still his two sai, but are slightly larger than in the other versions and can even be joined together to form a staff (similar to Billy's from Mighty Morphin' Power Rangers). He also owns a , which is his favorite means of transportation. It would also mark the first time Raph drives a motorcycle. Though it seemed Raphael despised the female turtle, the two of them seem to spend a lot of time with each other on the show, though this is usually when they are sparring.
